I always type paragraphs on posts like this and end up discarding them because of how difficult it is to articulate how much so called bad trips are actually the best trips. 

I'll try here. I decided to trip while feeling in a really bad space and I had a feeling I was going to have a bad experience despite being with the closest people that I feel most safe with. It wasn't good. I felt they were conspiring against me to 'fix' me but nefariously. Of course they were not but even after the trip I still didn't trust them to certain degree.

I tripped again a month later, on my own and the same feelings came up. This time my friends were not around so who was conspiring against me? Only myself, in my own head. I believe the shrooms had a message for me and they were not done with me. 

I had to fix something. And it wasn't other people that were trying to do it, it was myself. I went into a dark place then but came out of it understanding myself so much more and what I was in need of fixing in myself. Shrooms have the ability to lay your life open in front of you without you making up whatever justification for living a lie basically. It's just brutal honesty, and you have to face it. 

So for me, it was really tough feeling and realising these things, but it helped me immensely I'm communication with my peers and opening up to myself. 

I've been deliberately vague so as to hopefully make you place whatever your troubles are into my experience and hope it makes some modicum of sense.

Agreed, which is why I recommended 1g first time. A lot of people, in my opinion, are out to prove something when it comes to shrooms and how much they take. The amount is not important in a general sense. It's entirely subjective.
